testSuite.details: Full local suite passed: 296 passed in 12.55s

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Short Telegram team summary is generated for each team for the selected week.
Short Telegram team summary contains week, team, captain, active/dropped counts, victory percent, progress bar and percent.
PDF team report is generated for each team and saved under local non-public reports/pdf path policy.
PDF report includes summary, status distribution, risk/dropped participants, and participant sections.
Participant section includes identity, weekly status, progress, goal, steps, report text, transcription, and insights.
Dropped participants remain visible but are excluded from active victory percentage.
green, blue, red, gray use approved score rules and yellow late status is not used.
Main progress percent is based on planned steps and insights do not affect progress/status.
Reports use Google Sheets final facts and do not read unfinished SQLite drafts as report content.
Deleted original audio does not break reports; transcription_text is used.
Captain receives only own team Telegram summary and PDF.
Captain does not receive other teams, full summary, or group comparison.
Tracker receives only assigned reports by gender/team scope.
Ivan Larkin male scope and Maria female scope are supported by tracker gender_scope routing.
Tracker does not receive group comparison.
Admin receives all team reports, PDFs, full summary, group comparison, and errors.
Alexander Sitnikov receives all reports, PDFs, full summary, and group comparison.
Group comparison is sent only to admin and Alexander Sitnikov.
Missing recipient chat id does not block other recipients and notifies admin.
Send failure for one recipient does not block others and notifies admin.
PDF generation failure for one team is reported and does not break other teams.
Rerun for the same week does not duplicate already successful deliveries.
Report generation/send status is stored as technical state; final business facts remain in Sheets.
Generated PDFs, SQLite DBs, logs, credentials, and secrets are not committed.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: artifact scans returned no tracked PDF/SQLite/credential/secret files

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Feature does not add Docker, Redis, Celery, PostgreSQL, web admin panel, public leaderboard, or production deploy.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: git diff/file review; no deploy/runtime dependency files added

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Report aggregation reads final Google Sheets rows through SheetsGateway.
SQLite report state uses technical table names and does not create business-primary report_runs table.
PDF renderer writes local non-public files under StoragePathPolicy.pdf_path.
Bot document delivery is represented in bot boundary and fake client.
NotificationCategory.REPORT_DELIVERY uses notification bot only.
Recipient planner enforces captain, tracker, admin, and Sitnikov scopes.
Group comparison cannot be delivered to captains or trackers.
Report delivery is idempotent per recipient/report item.
Admin errors are sanitized and do not include secrets or raw personal report text.
Existing foundation, participant, weekly report, captain, insight, voice, and scheduler tests remain green.
No runtime dependency, deploy config, live adapter, generated PDF, SQLite DB, credential, or secret is committed.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: artifact scans returned no tracked forbidden files; no dependency/deploy files changed
